newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-INDIA PLAN TO KEEP THEIR HEADS V BANGLADES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA PLAN TO KEEP THEIR HEADS V BANGLADES.

text.p: Indian cricket captain Sachin Tendulkar said his players must keep their heads in Thursday's game against Bangladesh if they are to reach the Asia Cup final against Sri Lanka.
"We should not get desperate. Slogging will not help. We'll have to plan carefully and play a calculated game," Tendulkar said.
Speaking to Reuters late on Wednesday, Tendulkar said the controversy over some players whose names have been linked to a betting scandal back home would not affect his team's performance.
"The perfect answer to all this is to win tomorrow's game," he said.
India, whose net run rate is poor, need to restrict Bangladesh to a total of less than 150 runs and then knock the runs off in 20 overs if they are to reach the final.
Pakistan have three points from their three matches after the game against India was washed out due to rain on Sunday and Monday.
A win for India on Thursday will tie them with Pakistan on three points, and then the net run rate will decide which team meets the world champions in the final on Saturday.
India, the defending Asia Cup champions, have left out off-spinner Noel David in naming 13 players for Thursday's match.
The final team will be selected on the morning of the match after a final assessment of the pitch is made.

TEAMS: INDIA: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Navjot Sidhu, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Saba Karim, Robin Singh, Ajay Jadeja, Anil Kumble, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruwila, Nilesh Kulkarni, Debasis Mohanty.

BANGLADESH: Akram Khan (captain), Athar Ali Khan, Naimur Rahman, Habibul Bashar, Aminul Islam, Minjahul Abedin, Mafizur Rahman, Khalid Mashud, Habibul Hossain, Shaikh Salahuddin, Saiful Islam, Enamul Hoque, Zakir Hassan.
